notes: The italicized of God is rightly added under rule 5: no θεός token stands anywhere in the projection of this verse, and ὀργῇ's own English is complete at wrath, so rule 7 cannot fold it. Rule 103 is cited in the unit note but is not strictly in point, its case being a token already spent in the same verse.
Ἐμοὶ ἐκδίκησις takes the supplied belongeth unto on the dative predicate under rules 62 and 63, the subject being the noun ἐκδίκησις; the head is the pronoun's own word me.
λέγει κύριος is anarthrous, so the supplied the is a rule 7 helper on the noun (rule 51's anarthrous clause).
